title: Thai Squash and Jewel Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy skewer recipe combining the sweetness of butternut squash with the crunch of jewel-toned vegetables, all wrapped up in a Thai-inspired marinade.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together peanut oil, soy sauce, honey, and lime juice.
Add the cubed butternut squash and sliced bell peppers to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated squash and bell peppers onto the skewers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the squash is tender.
Garnish with crispy onions and chopped cilantro.
